---
applyTo: "app/javascript/**/*.{js,ts,vue},app/javascript/**/*.json"
---

# Frontend Instructions

- Reuse Chatwoot's existing components, composables, stores, API layers, and design tokens.
- Use i18n for all user-visible strings.
- Do not hard-code VibeExe colors where theme tokens or CSS variables can be used.
- Preserve accessibility, responsive behavior, loading states, empty states, and error states.
- Keep API calls in the established API/store layer.
- Avoid broad refactors while implementing focused product work.
- Add or update the smallest relevant frontend tests.
